sections.content: Every element is a box: content, padding (inside), border, margin (outside). box-sizing: border-box makes width include padding+border — almost always what you want.
Margins collapse vertically between siblings; padding never collapses. Inline elements ignore width/height until made block or inline-block.
Key points: debug layout with outline: 1px solid red, border-box is the modern default via reset, and margin: auto centers block elements horizontally.
